text: { "entries": [ { "name_han": "太古集", "logic_thesis": "Hao Datong argues that true realization is not progressive accumulation of techniques but a return to the primordial state (太古) in which yin–yang already balance without forced intervention. The text proves that cultivation succeeds only when the adept stops manufacturing dualistic effort and lets the original order of Heaven and Earth reassert itself in body and mind.", "logic_chain": "1) Primordial antiquity is the unforced balance of yin–yang before conceptual division. 2) Later ages lost that balance by clinging to form, name, and deliberate practice. 3) Therefore deliberate striving multiplies the very dualism it seeks to heal. 4) Alchemy, poetry, and image in the text are pointers back to pre-dual awareness, not recipes for adding power. 5) Conclusion: realization = restoring 太古 equilibrium, not fabricating a new self.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat a chart’s extremes (strong Fire, weak Water, etc.) as invitations to restore balance rather than to “stack” favorable gods. 2) Prefer timing strategies that reduce forced action when Day Master is already strained. 3) In cultivation, use breath/stillness to drop intentional “doing,” then observe when qi settles of itself. 4) Map 太古 to the moment before preference: read ten gods without narrative self-defense. 5) When a luck pillar “helps,” ask whether it restores balance or inflates attachment.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 渐悟集’s stepwise awakening rhetoric, 太古集 privileges sudden reversion to origin over graduated insight. Unlike 磻溪集’s travel-and-encounter pedagogy, it is more cosmological and imagistic. Its distinct claim is that the goal is not better technique but pre-technique order." }, { "name_han": "水云集", "logic_thesis": "Tan Chuduan proves that the Dao is verified in fluid, non-grasping presence—like water and cloud—rather than in fixed monastery form or literary display. The collection argues that purity of intention and spontaneous response to circumstances are the real proofs of attainment, not institutional rank.", "logic_chain": "1) Water and cloud take shape without clinging to shape. 2) The Quanzhen adept must likewise meet society, weather, and emotion without hardening into identity. 3) Verse and song are vehicles of this fluidity, not ends. 4) Clinging to purity as an image is still clinging. 5) Conclusion: authentic practice is adaptive clarity under changing conditions.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling, refuse one-size-fits-all “good/bad” labels; read context like water taking the vessel. 2) When luck pillars shift, reframe advice as adaptation, not fate-fixation. 3) Cultivate non-reactive speech when client charts trigger judgment. 4) Use soft timing (waiting for supportive cycles) over forced breakthroughs. 5) Track whether your method clings to school dogma or stays responsive.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 云光集’s more didactic moral-cosmic framing, 水云集 emphasizes poetic fluidity and social encounter. Unlike 丹阳神光灿’s dense ci-lyric alchemy of light, it stresses everyday non-attachment. Difference: proof is in behavioral softness, not in symbolic brilliance." }, { "name_han": "渐悟集", "logic_thesis": "The text argues that awakening is cumulative and lawful: each stage of insight depends on prior purification of desire, body, and intention. It proves that sudden claims of enlightenment without graduated self-correction are self-deception, while patient correction of mind yields irreversible clarity.", "logic_chain": "1) Defilements obscure nature in layers, not all at once. 2) Therefore practice must peel layers in sequence (conduct → intention → subtle clinging). 3) Each verified insight stabilizes the next. 4) Skipping stages produces unstable “enlightenment.” 5) Conclusion: gradual verification is the logic of durable realization.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi study, master stems/branches → ten gods → combinations → luck pillars in order; do not jump to grand narrative. 2) For clients, sequence advice: stabilize health/relations before career gambles. 3) In cultivation, set measurable daily renunciations before advanced visualization. 4) Journal “what dissolved this month” as stage evidence. 5) Treat major luck changes as new stages requiring re-verification, not permanent identity.", "logic_compare": "It differs from 太古集’s reversion-to-origin emphasis by insisting on staged work. It differs from 孙不二元君法语’s gender-specific alchemical path by remaining more general Quanzhen gradualism. Why: its logic is pedagogical sequencing, not cosmological nostalgia or specialized female alchemy." }, { "name_han": "道德真经注", "logic_thesis": "This commentary (Daoist exegetical line on the Daodejing) proves that Laozi’s dark, soft, empty language is not mystification but a coherent ontology: the Dao’s efficacy appears as non-contention and return. It argues that political and personal order both fail when force replaces alignment with the formless root.", "logic_chain": "1) Named things arise from the nameless root. 2) Governing or cultivating by grasping names multiplies disorder. 3) Softness and emptiness are modes of residual power, not weakness. 4) Commentary unpacks paradoxes into operable principles (return, frugality, non-contention). 5) Conclusion: the text is a system of causal ethics grounded in cosmology, not poetry alone.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, privilege root causes (seasonal command, Day Master strength) over flashy combinations. 2) Prefer “soft” remedies—timing, environment, restraint—over aggressive god-stacking. 3) When a chart shows over-control (strong Officer without Resource), counsel non-contention. 4) Read empty/void patterns as functional space, not mere defect. 5) Align life strategy with “return”: simplify when complexity peaks.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 道德真经传’s often more historical-political transmission framing, a 注 focuses on line-by-line ontological unpacking. Unlike 老子注 in the Wang Bi philosophical style, Daoist 注 typically preserves cultivation and cosmic qi readings. Difference: method is lemma exegesis tied to practice efficacy." }, { "name_han": "道德真经传", "logic_thesis": "The “transmission” genre proves that Laozi’s teaching is a living lineage of meaning—how the Way is handed down and applied in governance and self-rule—not a closed literary puzzle. It argues that correct transmission preserves both wording and the practical logic of non-action as statecraft and self-cultivation.", "logic_chain": "1) A classic dies if only recited without transmission of intent. 2) Transmission must show how paradoxes apply to order (self/state). 3) Historical/philosophical framing anchors abstract Dao in human institutions. 4) Mis-transmission turns softness into passivity or cunning. 5) Conclusion: authority of the text rests on correct practical lineage of meaning.", "logic_practice": "1) When teaching BaZi, transmit not only formulas but the “why” of balance and timing. 2) Build apprentice sequences: observation → pattern → exception → ethics of counsel. 3) Audit your “school rules” for passive fatalism vs. adaptive non-action. 4) Keep a transmission log: which interpretations improve client outcomes. 5) Refuse secretism that blocks verification.", "logic_compare": "Unlike pure 注 that prioritizes word-level ontology, 传 emphasizes continuity of application across contexts. Unlike Quanzhen poetic collections, it remains classic-centered. Why different: its logic is pedagogical-political continuity, not mystical lyric or staged alchemy alone." }, { "name_han": "老子注", "logic_thesis": "A classical Laozi commentary proves that apparent contradictions in the text resolve once one distinguishes levels: Dao as unnameable source vs. De as manifested virtue. It argues that error arises when readers flatten levels—treating emptiness as nihilism or softness as strategy only.", "logic_chain": "1) Laozi speaks on multiple logical levels in one line. 2) Without level-distinction, readers produce fatalism or manipulation. 3) Commentary re-stratifies metaphysics, ethics, and politics. 4) Correct stratification yields coherent practice: empty mind, soft conduct, ordered society. 5) Conclusion: interpretive discipline is itself cultivation of clarity.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, separate structural level (framework strength) from surface events (ten-god manifestations). 2) Never confuse “empty” charts with meaninglessness—map function of voids. 3) Train dual reading: metaphysical lesson of a pillar + concrete life advice. 4) When texts conflict, check level mismatch before choosing sides. 5) Use commentary discipline: define terms before forecasting.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 道德真经注/传, a generic 老子注 may be more philosophical (e.g., Wang Bi) and less liturgical. Compared with Quanzhen collections, it lacks autobiographical practice narrative. Difference: it is meta-logic of reading Laozi rather than a personal path text." }, { "name_han": "道德真经注", "logic_thesis": "A second major Daodejing annotation tradition proves that the classic’s political quietism is inseparable from body-mind quietism: the same causality of excess force ruining order applies to empire and to qi. It argues that annotation must restore operable causal links between soft governance and personal conservation of essence.", "logic_chain": "1) Excess control depletes the root (state or body). 2) Laozi’s frugality and non-contention are conservation laws. 3) Annotation maps these laws onto rulers’ and cultivators’ decisions. 4) Therefore ethical restraint is not optional piety but causal hygiene. 5) Conclusion: reading the classic without conservation logic is incomplete.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat over-favorable luck as risk of overspend of yuanqi—counsel restraint. 2) Map Officer/Kill pressure to governance of self: over-control → illness/relations break. 3) Prefer conservation strategies in weak-Day-Master charts. 4) Use yearly cycles to schedule rest, not only peak action. 5) Annotate your own readings: where did you push force against the chart’s root?", "logic_compare": "Relative to the other 道德真经注 entry’s focus on emptiness ontology, this line stresses conservation causality (治身=治国). Relative to 渐悟集, it is classic-exegesis rather than Quanzhen stage poetry. Why: dual application of one causal law across body and polity." }, { "name_han": "磻溪集", "logic_thesis": "Qiu Chuji’s 磻溪集 proves that authentic Quanzhen attainment is forged in exile, hardship, and dialogue with place—not in comfort or mere doctrine. The text argues that landscape, weather, and social trial are the true alchemical furnace that tests whether emptiness is real.", "logic_chain": "1) Doctrine untested by hardship is verbal. 2) Qiu’s Panxi sojourn stages continuous encounter with cold, hunger, and visitors. 3) Verse records verification: mind unmoved yet responsive. 4) Therefore place and ordeal are methods, not accidents. 5) Conclusion: the Dao is proven under pressure of circumstance.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat clash/harm years as furnace tests—specify what virtue is being tested. 2) Design “ordeal practices”: silence, travel, simplified living in hard luck periods. 3) Read environmental factors (house, climate) as active agents in chart expression. 4) After a crisis pillar passes, extract verified lessons, not just relief. 5) Counsel clients on capacity-building before predicted storms.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 水云集’s softer fluidity image, 磻溪集 centers rigorous mountain exile. Unlike 太古集’s cosmological primitivism, it is autobiographical ordeal pedagogy. Difference: proof-condition is hardship in a named place and life." }, { "name_han": "云光集", "logic_thesis": "Wang Chuyi’s 云光集 proves that moral clarity and cosmic light are one continuum: when intention is upright, response from Heaven is luminous and timely. It argues that “cloud light” is not mere metaphor but the experiential sign that personal virtue has aligned with celestial pattern.", "logic_chain": "1) Clouds veil or reveal light depending on conditions. 2) Human turbidity is the veil; sincerity clears it. 3) Luminous experiences and accurate responses follow cleared intention. 4) Thus ethics is epistemic: purity improves perception of pattern. 5) Conclusion: cultivation of virtue is cultivation of correct seeing.", "logic_practice": "1) Before BaZi reading, purify motive—refuse readings that feed fear-selling. 2) Use “light” criteria: does the reading increase client agency and clarity? 3) Align daily conduct with chart lessons (e.g., if Resource weak, study honestly). 4) Track synchronicities as feedback, not superstition—verify repeatability. 5) Practice quiet sitting until mental “cloud cover” thins, then read charts.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 丹阳神光灿’s dense alchemical radiance language, 云光集 more strongly links light to moral-cosmic response. Compared with 水云集, it is less about fluid non-form and more about luminous confirmation. Why: virtue → clarity is its core causal thesis." }, { "name_han": "孙不二元君法语", "logic_thesis": "Sun Bu’er’s sayings prove that women’s alchemy is not a reduced copy of male paths but a distinct logic of body, blood, and reverse refinement that still aims at the same non-dual nature. The text argues that correct method must respect sexual-physiological difference while refusing the claim that women cannot complete the Dao.", "logic_chain": "1) Bodies differ in generative economy (blood/essence pathways). 2) Therefore methods of conservation and reverse flow must be tailored. 3) Tailoring is not ontological inferiority. 4) Graduated female practice leads to the same luminous nature. 5) Conclusion: universal Dao + differential method is the coherent position.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, weight chart reading by actual physiology/life stage (menarche, pregnancy, menopause analogs in timing), not only abstract Day Master. 2) Avoid one-gender default remedies in health luck analysis. 3) For cultivation advice, separate universal ethics from body-specific technique. 4) Study yin-heavy charts without pathologizing yin. 5) Use Sun’s model: customize sequence, keep the same end-state of non-dual clarity.", "logic_compare": "Differs from male Quanzhen poetry (丹阳, 磻溪) by explicit female alchemical sequencing. Differs from generic Laozi注释 by being path-instructional rather than classic exegesis. Why unique: differential embodiment as logical necessity inside universal Dao." }, { "name_han": "丹阳神光灿", "logic_thesis": "Ma Danyang’s 神光灿 proves that inner light is the verifiable criterion of true alchemy: when desire cools and intention unifies, radiance appears as both poetic fact and somatic sign. It argues that literary brilliance without settled light is empty, while settled light without compassion is incomplete.", "logic_chain": "1) Scattered desire scatters spirit-light. 2) Quanzhen discipline gathers light into stable presence. 3) Ci-lyric form records and transmits that gathered state. 4) Social teaching must share light, not hoard mystique. 5) Conclusion: radiant mind is the measurable fruit of practice.", "logic_practice": "1) Use “is mind brighter/calmer?” as daily KPI after meditation, not occult fantasy. 2) In BaZi years of Fire excess, train cooling and gathering rather than stimulation. 3) Read “light” periods (supportive Resource/Output) as windows for study and teaching. 4) Convert poetic inspiration into ethical action same day. 5) When forecasting, ask what practice would gather the client’s scattered shen.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 云光集’s virtue-response cosmology, 丹阳神光灿 emphasizes aesthetic-somatic radiance of the adept’s mind. Unlike 渐悟集’s stage tables, it proves by lyrical intensity of realized light. Difference: verification medium is 神光 itself." }, { "name_han": "黄帝龙首经", "logic_thesis": "The Longshou Jing proves that celestial configurations and calendrical positions can be reduced to a rule-governed head (龙首) of method: divination works when operators follow invariant structural mappings, not whim. It argues that Heaven’s patterns are legible through standardized procedures linking time, direction, and query.", "logic_chain": "1) Heaven exhibits regular motions and stations. 2) Human affairs correlate if mapped by fixed algorithms. 3) The classic supplies those algorithms (龙首 method). 4) Accuracy depends on correct time-space setup and question framing. 5) Conclusion: divination is applied cosmology under discipline, not prophecy theater.", "logic_practice": "1) Standardize BaZi intake: true solar time, place, question scope. 2) Separate structural chart facts from interpretive story. 3) Use directional/temporal gods only with explicit rules. 4) Keep a hit-rate log to discipline method. 5) Refuse readings when data (birth time) fails minimum reliability.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 通占大象历星经’s broader star-lore synthesis, 龙首经 is method-manual focused. Unlike Quanzhen inner alchemy collections, it is externalized cosmo-divination. Why: operational algorithm as the proof of Heaven-human correlation." }, { "name_han": "黄帝金匮玉衡经", "logic_thesis": "This classic proves that authoritative cosmic judgment (金匮) and balanced standard (玉衡) together form a complete decision system: secrets of Heaven must be stored carefully and weighed with a stable fulcrum. It argues that without both archival rule and balanced judgment, operators either leak order or misweigh cases.", "logic_chain": "1) Cosmic patterns are precious and easy to misuse. 2) Hence “金匮”: restricted, exact transmission of rules. 3) “玉衡”: every case must be weighed on a constant standard. 4) Rule without balance becomes rigid error; balance without rule becomes whim. 5) Conclusion: ethical-technical dual control is required for true art.", "logic_practice": "1) Maintain a private “金匮” of verified BaZi rules vs. public simplified teaching. 2) Build a 玉衡 checklist: season, strength, useful god, luck, ethics of advice. 3) Never publish client-identifying cases. 4) Re-weigh edge cases against the same standard yearly. 5) When two schools conflict, apply balance criteria rather than prestige.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 龙首经’s procedural head-method, 金匮玉衡 emphasizes custody + weighing of authority. Compared with 道教义枢’s doctrinal taxonomy, it is divinatory-operational. Difference: dual metaphor of vault and balance as logic of responsible cosmic arts." }, { "name_han": "通占大象历星经", "logic_thesis": "The text proves that large-scale celestial images (大象) and calendrical stars form a unified prognostic language: weather, omens, and human fortune are readable when star-calendar correlations are systematically held. It argues that fragmented omen-reading fails without a complete map of stellar offices and seasonal measures.", "logic_chain": "1) Stars and lunar stations encode offices and qualities. 2) Calendar binds those offices to time. 3) “通占” requires cross-domain application (sky → earth → man). 4) Incomplete catalogs produce partial, false certainty. 5) Conclusion: comprehensive star-calendar synthesis is the condition of reliable omen logic.", "logic_practice": "1) Integrate BaZi with basic lunar mansion/seasonal context when relevant. 2) Do not isolate day-pillar from larger sky-season frame. 3) For annual forecasts, cross-check stem-branch year with major stellar seasonal markers. 4) Study historical omen cases as catalog training. 5) Keep scope humility: chart is one subsystem of 大象.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 龙首经’s tighter algorithmic manual, this is encyclopedic star-omen synthesis. Unlike inner-alchemy poetry, it externalizes fate reading to sky images. Why different: completeness of celestial catalog as epistemic requirement." }, { "name_han": "太上老君说报父母恩重经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that cosmic and social order depend on repaying parental grace: filial debt is not mere custom but a structural debt in the Daoist moral universe. It argues that cultivation that abandons parents without repayment logic is self-contradictory, because life-body is received capital.", "logic_chain": "1) Body, breath, and life chances are received from parents. 2) Daoist practice uses that received capital. 3) Therefore ethical return (孝/报恩) is owed. 4) Heaven’s response tracks this moral accounting. 5) Conclusion: liberation practices must include repayment of foundational human debt.", "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi family palace analysis, treat parental bonds as primary ethical field, not only luck variables. 2) Prescribe concrete repayment acts (care, ritual, support) in hard family years. 3) When charts show parent-child clash, design reconciliation practices before “cutting ties” rhetoric. 4) Frame cultivation time budget to include filial duty. 5) Read Resource/Parent stars as reminders of received grace.", "logic_compare": "Unlike pure metaphysics of Laozi commentaries, this is narrative-ethical scripture. Unlike 救苦经 texts that emphasize universal salvation, it prioritizes the parent-child debt axis. Why: specific moral causality of 报恩 as structural." }, { "name_han": "太上老君说安宅八阳经", "logic_thesis": "The scripture proves that dwelling is a cosmological organ: a house misaligned with yang order becomes a generator of calamity, while ritual and correct orientation restore eightfold bright order. It argues that safety is not only walls and luck but ritual-spatial alignment with celestial yang.", "logic_chain": "1) Humans inhabit patterned space under Heaven. 2) Disorder of site/spirits disorders residents’ qi and fortune. 3) 八阳 names a complete set of bright, ordering forces. 4) Recitation/rite realigns the dwelling’s field. 5) Conclusion: domestic security is a liturgical-cosmological problem as much as material.", "logic_practice": "1) Couple BaZi home-luck advice with basic orientation, light, cleanliness, and ethical household conduct. 2) In years of home clash (property stars disturbed), prioritize 安宅 practices. 3) Treat “house ghosts” psychologically and ritually: reduce fear, restore order. 4) Use eightfold checklists (doors, light, sleep, stove, etc.) as modern 八阳 analogs. 5) Never sell fear; aim at restored yang clarity.", "logic_compare": "Differs from star classics by focusing on domestic space rather than sky catalog. Differs from Quanzhen inner practice by externalizing order to the residence. Why: architecture-spirit-human triad as its unique causal unit." }, { "name_han": "太上老君说天妃救苦灵验经", "logic_thesis": "The text proves that celestial compassion (天妃) is efficacious when suffering beings call with sincerity: rescue is a lawful response within a theistic-Daoist cosmos, not random miracle. It argues that devotion plus moral turning activates a named salvific office that specializes in peril at sea and analogous crises.", "logic_chain": "1) The cosmos includes responsive sacred persons/offices. 2) 天妃’s vow-field covers acute peril and wandering distress. 3) Sincere invocation + repentance opens the response channel. 4) “灵验” is claimed as repeatable efficacy under conditions. 5) Conclusion: relational devotion is a valid soteriological technology.", "logic_practice": "1) In crisis luck years (Travel, Water hazards, isolation), combine practical safety with vow/recitation if client’s faith-framework allows. 2) Map “救苦” to concrete help networks, not only prayer. 3) Use the text’s logic to counter fatalism: response is possible. 4) Ethical preparation: stop harm-causing behavior that co-produces suffering. 5) Document outcomes as humility, not marketing.", "logic_compare": "Unlike 报父母恩重经’s filial accounting, this centers a female celestial rescuer’s vow. Unlike abstract Laozi ontology, it is devotional-soteriological. Difference: named office of compassion with testimonial efficacy structure." }, { "name_han": "太上洞玄灵宝天尊说救苦妙经", "logic_thesis": "This Lingbao scripture proves that suffering is structurally addressable by the 救苦天尊’s universal vow: recitation realigns the soul with a salvation circuit that spans the ten directions. It argues that “妙” means the method is simple yet cosmically complete—sound, name, and intention open the path out of distress realms.", "logic_chain": "1) Beings cycle through painful states by karmic inertia. 2) 救苦天尊 establishes a counter-inertia of compassion. 3) Holding the name/scripture hooks the being into that counter-field. 4) Therefore liberation help is available without elite learning. 5) Conclusion: accessibility of salvation is itself a doctrinal proof of cosmic compassion.", "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi charts heavy in Kill/Empty/loss patterns, pair forecast with practices that reduce despair (recitation, charity, counseling). 2) Teach clients a short daily 救苦 practice as emotional-spiritual first aid. 3) Read “ten directions” as expanding care beyond self-chart obsession. 4) In death/grief timing, use the scripture’s hope logic ethically. 5) Keep method simple: consistency over complexity.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 天妃经’s specialized maritime/female cult focus, 救苦妙经 is more universal Lingbao soteriology. Compared with 安宅经, the field is the soul-realms rather than the house. Why: universal vow + easy recitation as the logical center." }, { "name_han": "三洞珠囊", "logic_thesis": "The encyclopedia proves that Daoism’s authority rests on organized totality: Three Caverns materials must be anthologized so practitioners can locate authentic teaching amid proliferation. It argues that “pearls in a pouch” are selected essentials—curation is a logical act that preserves orthodoxy and usability.", "logic_chain": "1) Scriptural mass without organization yields confusion. 2) Three Caverns provide a high-level architecture. 3) Anthology extracts portable “pearls.” 4) Users can then practice and teach from a coherent corpus. 5) Conclusion: bibliographic structure is doctrinal method, not mere librarianship.", "logic_practice": "1) Build your BaZi/Daoist study pouch: core classics first, commentaries second, folklore last. 2) Tag techniques by cavern/level (cosmology, ritual, alchemy, ethics). 3) When sources conflict, prefer curated classical layers. 4) Create personal 珠囊 notes of only verified methods. 5) Teach students a map of the library before isolated tricks.", "logic_compare": "Unlike single-author Quanzhen collections, it is multi-source anthology logic. Unlike 道教义枢’s abstract doctrinal pivots, it is materials assembly. Difference: selection-and-arrangement as the form of reasoning." }, { "name_han": "道教义枢", "logic_thesis": "道教义枢 proves that Daoist teachings, however diverse, hinge on a finite set of doctrinal pivots (义枢): clarify those hinges and the whole system becomes navigable. It argues that conceptual architecture—body, spirit, Dao, practice ranks—prevents sectarian drift and empty ritualism.", "logic_chain": "1) Practices without doctrinal hinges become superstition or aesthetics. 2) The text isolates key meanings that organize all lesser topics. 3) With pivots fixed, rituals and alchemy find their places. 4) Disputes can be adjudicated by reference to hinges, not fashion. 5) Conclusion: systematic theology/philosophy is necessary for living Daoism.", "logic_practice": "1) For each BaZi technique, state its hinge: balance? image? response? ethics? 2) Build a one-page 义枢 of your consulting philosophy. 3) When learning a new school, map it onto existing pivots before adopting. 4) Audit practice: which actions serve no hinge? cut them. 5) Use pivots to explain forecasts to clients without occult fog.", "logic_compare": "Compared with 三洞珠囊’s anthology approach, 义枢 is conceptual system-building. Compared with Laozi 注/传, it systematizes the whole religion, not one classic. Why distinct: hinge-concepts as the master logic of orthodoxy and practice integration." } ] }

Why: its logic is pedagogical sequencing, not cosmological nostalgia or specialized female alchemy.

entries.logic_thesis: This commentary (Daoist exegetical line on the Daodejing) proves that Laozi’s dark, soft, empty language is not mystification but a coherent ontology: the Dao’s efficacy appears as non-contention and return. It argues that political and personal order both fail when force replaces alignment with the formless root.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Named things arise from the nameless root. 2) Governing or cultivating by grasping names multiplies disorder. 3) Softness and emptiness are modes of residual power, not weakness. 4) Commentary unpacks paradoxes into operable principles (return, frugality, non-contention). 5) Conclusion: the text is a system of causal ethics grounded in cosmology, not poetry alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, privilege root causes (seasonal command, Day Master strength) over flashy combinations. 2) Prefer “soft” remedies—timing, environment, restraint—over aggressive god-stacking. 3) When a chart shows over-control (strong Officer without Resource), counsel non-contention. 4) Read empty/void patterns as functional space, not mere defect. 5) Align life strategy with “return”: simplify when complexity peaks.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 道德真经传’s often more historical-political transmission framing, a 注 focuses on line-by-line ontological unpacking. Unlike 老子注 in the Wang Bi philosophical style, Daoist 注 typically preserves cultivation and cosmic qi readings. Difference: method is lemma exegesis tied to practice efficacy.

entries.logic_thesis: The “transmission” genre proves that Laozi’s teaching is a living lineage of meaning—how the Way is handed down and applied in governance and self-rule—not a closed literary puzzle. It argues that correct transmission preserves both wording and the practical logic of non-action as statecraft and self-cultivation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) A classic dies if only recited without transmission of intent. 2) Transmission must show how paradoxes apply to order (self/state). 3) Historical/philosophical framing anchors abstract Dao in human institutions. 4) Mis-transmission turns softness into passivity or cunning. 5) Conclusion: authority of the text rests on correct practical lineage of meaning.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When teaching BaZi, transmit not only formulas but the “why” of balance and timing. 2) Build apprentice sequences: observation → pattern → exception → ethics of counsel. 3) Audit your “school rules” for passive fatalism vs. adaptive non-action. 4) Keep a transmission log: which interpretations improve client outcomes. 5) Refuse secretism that blocks verification.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure 注 that prioritizes word-level ontology, 传 emphasizes continuity of application across contexts. Unlike Quanzhen poetic collections, it remains classic-centered. Why different: its logic is pedagogical-political continuity, not mystical lyric or staged alchemy alone.

entries.logic_thesis: A classical Laozi commentary proves that apparent contradictions in the text resolve once one distinguishes levels: Dao as unnameable source vs. De as manifested virtue. It argues that error arises when readers flatten levels—treating emptiness as nihilism or softness as strategy only.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Laozi speaks on multiple logical levels in one line. 2) Without level-distinction, readers produce fatalism or manipulation. 3) Commentary re-stratifies metaphysics, ethics, and politics. 4) Correct stratification yields coherent practice: empty mind, soft conduct, ordered society. 5) Conclusion: interpretive discipline is itself cultivation of clarity.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, separate structural level (framework strength) from surface events (ten-god manifestations). 2) Never confuse “empty” charts with meaninglessness—map function of voids. 3) Train dual reading: metaphysical lesson of a pillar + concrete life advice. 4) When texts conflict, check level mismatch before choosing sides. 5) Use commentary discipline: define terms before forecasting.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 道德真经注/传, a generic 老子注 may be more philosophical (e.g., Wang Bi) and less liturgical. Compared with Quanzhen collections, it lacks autobiographical practice narrative. Difference: it is meta-logic of reading Laozi rather than a personal path text.

entries.logic_thesis: A second major Daodejing annotation tradition proves that the classic’s political quietism is inseparable from body-mind quietism: the same causality of excess force ruining order applies to empire and to qi. It argues that annotation must restore operable causal links between soft governance and personal conservation of essence.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Excess control depletes the root (state or body). 2) Laozi’s frugality and non-contention are conservation laws. 3) Annotation maps these laws onto rulers’ and cultivators’ decisions. 4) Therefore ethical restraint is not optional piety but causal hygiene. 5) Conclusion: reading the classic without conservation logic is incomplete.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat over-favorable luck as risk of overspend of yuanqi—counsel restraint. 2) Map Officer/Kill pressure to governance of self: over-control → illness/relations break. 3) Prefer conservation strategies in weak-Day-Master charts. 4) Use yearly cycles to schedule rest, not only peak action. 5) Annotate your own readings: where did you push force against the chart’s root?
entries.logic_compare: Relative to the other 道德真经注 entry’s focus on emptiness ontology, this line stresses conservation causality (治身=治国). Relative to 渐悟集, it is classic-exegesis rather than Quanzhen stage poetry. Why: dual application of one causal law across body and polity.

entries.logic_thesis: Qiu Chuji’s 磻溪集 proves that authentic Quanzhen attainment is forged in exile, hardship, and dialogue with place—not in comfort or mere doctrine. The text argues that landscape, weather, and social trial are the true alchemical furnace that tests whether emptiness is real.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Doctrine untested by hardship is verbal. 2) Qiu’s Panxi sojourn stages continuous encounter with cold, hunger, and visitors. 3) Verse records verification: mind unmoved yet responsive. 4) Therefore place and ordeal are methods, not accidents. 5) Conclusion: the Dao is proven under pressure of circumstance.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat clash/harm years as furnace tests—specify what virtue is being tested. 2) Design “ordeal practices”: silence, travel, simplified living in hard luck periods. 3) Read environmental factors (house, climate) as active agents in chart expression. 4) After a crisis pillar passes, extract verified lessons, not just relief. 5) Counsel clients on capacity-building before predicted storms.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 水云集’s softer fluidity image, 磻溪集 centers rigorous mountain exile. Unlike 太古集’s cosmological primitivism, it is autobiographical ordeal pedagogy. Difference: proof-condition is hardship in a named place and life.

entries.logic_thesis: Wang Chuyi’s 云光集 proves that moral clarity and cosmic light are one continuum: when intention is upright, response from Heaven is luminous and timely. It argues that “cloud light” is not mere metaphor but the experiential sign that personal virtue has aligned with celestial pattern.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Clouds veil or reveal light depending on conditions. 2) Human turbidity is the veil; sincerity clears it. 3) Luminous experiences and accurate responses follow cleared intention. 4) Thus ethics is epistemic: purity improves perception of pattern. 5) Conclusion: cultivation of virtue is cultivation of correct seeing.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before BaZi reading, purify motive—refuse readings that feed fear-selling. 2) Use “light” criteria: does the reading increase client agency and clarity? 3) Align daily conduct with chart lessons (e.g., if Resource weak, study honestly). 4) Track synchronicities as feedback, not superstition—verify repeatability. 5) Practice quiet sitting until mental “cloud cover” thins, then read charts.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 丹阳神光灿’s dense alchemical radiance language, 云光集 more strongly links light to moral-cosmic response. Compared with 水云集, it is less about fluid non-form and more about luminous confirmation. Why: virtue → clarity is its core causal thesis.

entries.logic_thesis: Sun Bu’er’s sayings prove that women’s alchemy is not a reduced copy of male paths but a distinct logic of body, blood, and reverse refinement that still aims at the same non-dual nature. The text argues that correct method must respect sexual-physiological difference while refusing the claim that women cannot complete the Dao.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Bodies differ in generative economy (blood/essence pathways). 2) Therefore methods of conservation and reverse flow must be tailored. 3) Tailoring is not ontological inferiority. 4) Graduated female practice leads to the same luminous nature. 5) Conclusion: universal Dao + differential method is the coherent position.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, weight chart reading by actual physiology/life stage (menarche, pregnancy, menopause analogs in timing), not only abstract Day Master. 2) Avoid one-gender default remedies in health luck analysis. 3) For cultivation advice, separate universal ethics from body-specific technique. 4) Study yin-heavy charts without pathologizing yin. 5) Use Sun’s model: customize sequence, keep the same end-state of non-dual clarity.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from male Quanzhen poetry (丹阳, 磻溪) by explicit female alchemical sequencing. Differs from generic Laozi注释 by being path-instructional rather than classic exegesis. Why unique: differential embodiment as logical necessity inside universal Dao.

entries.logic_thesis: Ma Danyang’s 神光灿 proves that inner light is the verifiable criterion of true alchemy: when desire cools and intention unifies, radiance appears as both poetic fact and somatic sign. It argues that literary brilliance without settled light is empty, while settled light without compassion is incomplete.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Scattered desire scatters spirit-light. 2) Quanzhen discipline gathers light into stable presence. 3) Ci-lyric form records and transmits that gathered state. 4) Social teaching must share light, not hoard mystique. 5) Conclusion: radiant mind is the measurable fruit of practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use “is mind brighter/calmer?” as daily KPI after meditation, not occult fantasy. 2) In BaZi years of Fire excess, train cooling and gathering rather than stimulation. 3) Read “light” periods (supportive Resource/Output) as windows for study and teaching. 4) Convert poetic inspiration into ethical action same day. 5) When forecasting, ask what practice would gather the client’s scattered shen.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 云光集’s virtue-response cosmology, 丹阳神光灿 emphasizes aesthetic-somatic radiance of the adept’s mind. Unlike 渐悟集’s stage tables, it proves by lyrical intensity of realized light. Difference: verification medium is 神光 itself.

entries.logic_thesis: The Longshou Jing proves that celestial configurations and calendrical positions can be reduced to a rule-governed head (龙首) of method: divination works when operators follow invariant structural mappings, not whim. It argues that Heaven’s patterns are legible through standardized procedures linking time, direction, and query.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven exhibits regular motions and stations. 2) Human affairs correlate if mapped by fixed algorithms. 3) The classic supplies those algorithms (龙首 method). 4) Accuracy depends on correct time-space setup and question framing. 5) Conclusion: divination is applied cosmology under discipline, not prophecy theater.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Standardize BaZi intake: true solar time, place, question scope. 2) Separate structural chart facts from interpretive story. 3) Use directional/temporal gods only with explicit rules. 4) Keep a hit-rate log to discipline method. 5) Refuse readings when data (birth time) fails minimum reliability.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 通占大象历星经’s broader star-lore synthesis, 龙首经 is method-manual focused. Unlike Quanzhen inner alchemy collections, it is externalized cosmo-divination. Why: operational algorithm as the proof of Heaven-human correlation.

entries.logic_thesis: This classic proves that authoritative cosmic judgment (金匮) and balanced standard (玉衡) together form a complete decision system: secrets of Heaven must be stored carefully and weighed with a stable fulcrum. It argues that without both archival rule and balanced judgment, operators either leak order or misweigh cases.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cosmic patterns are precious and easy to misuse. 2) Hence “金匮”: restricted, exact transmission of rules. 3) “玉衡”: every case must be weighed on a constant standard. 4) Rule without balance becomes rigid error; balance without rule becomes whim. 5) Conclusion: ethical-technical dual control is required for true art.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Maintain a private “金匮” of verified BaZi rules vs. public simplified teaching. 2) Build a 玉衡 checklist: season, strength, useful god, luck, ethics of advice. 3) Never publish client-identifying cases. 4) Re-weigh edge cases against the same standard yearly. 5) When two schools conflict, apply balance criteria rather than prestige.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 龙首经’s procedural head-method, 金匮玉衡 emphasizes custody + weighing of authority. Compared with 道教义枢’s doctrinal taxonomy, it is divinatory-operational. Difference: dual metaphor of vault and balance as logic of responsible cosmic arts.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that large-scale celestial images (大象) and calendrical stars form a unified prognostic language: weather, omens, and human fortune are readable when star-calendar correlations are systematically held. It argues that fragmented omen-reading fails without a complete map of stellar offices and seasonal measures.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Stars and lunar stations encode offices and qualities. 2) Calendar binds those offices to time. 3) “通占” requires cross-domain application (sky → earth → man). 4) Incomplete catalogs produce partial, false certainty. 5) Conclusion: comprehensive star-calendar synthesis is the condition of reliable omen logic.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Integrate BaZi with basic lunar mansion/seasonal context when relevant. 2) Do not isolate day-pillar from larger sky-season frame. 3) For annual forecasts, cross-check stem-branch year with major stellar seasonal markers. 4) Study historical omen cases as catalog training. 5) Keep scope humility: chart is one subsystem of 大象.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 龙首经’s tighter algorithmic manual, this is encyclopedic star-omen synthesis. Unlike inner-alchemy poetry, it externalizes fate reading to sky images. Why different: completeness of celestial catalog as epistemic requirement.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说报父母恩重经
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that cosmic and social order depend on repaying parental grace: filial debt is not mere custom but a structural debt in the Daoist moral universe. It argues that cultivation that abandons parents without repayment logic is self-contradictory, because life-body is received capital.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Body, breath, and life chances are received from parents. 2) Daoist practice uses that received capital. 3) Therefore ethical return (孝/报恩) is owed. 4) Heaven’s response tracks this moral accounting. 5) Conclusion: liberation practices must include repayment of foundational human debt.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi family palace analysis, treat parental bonds as primary ethical field, not only luck variables. 2) Prescribe concrete repayment acts (care, ritual, support) in hard family years. 3) When charts show parent-child clash, design reconciliation practices before “cutting ties” rhetoric. 4) Frame cultivation time budget to include filial duty. 5) Read Resource/Parent stars as reminders of received grace.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure metaphysics of Laozi commentaries, this is narrative-ethical scripture. Unlike 救苦经 texts that emphasize universal salvation, it prioritizes the parent-child debt axis. Why: specific moral causality of 报恩 as structural.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说安宅八阳经
entries.logic_thesis: The scripture proves that dwelling is a cosmological organ: a house misaligned with yang order becomes a generator of calamity, while ritual and correct orientation restore eightfold bright order. It argues that safety is not only walls and luck but ritual-spatial alignment with celestial yang.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Humans inhabit patterned space under Heaven. 2) Disorder of site/spirits disorders residents’ qi and fortune. 3) 八阳 names a complete set of bright, ordering forces. 4) Recitation/rite realigns the dwelling’s field. 5) Conclusion: domestic security is a liturgical-cosmological problem as much as material.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Couple BaZi home-luck advice with basic orientation, light, cleanliness, and ethical household conduct. 2) In years of home clash (property stars disturbed), prioritize 安宅 practices. 3) Treat “house ghosts” psychologically and ritually: reduce fear, restore order. 4) Use eightfold checklists (doors, light, sleep, stove, etc.) as modern 八阳 analogs. 5) Never sell fear; aim at restored yang clarity.
entries.logic_compare: Differs from star classics by focusing on domestic space rather than sky catalog. Differs from Quanzhen inner practice by externalizing order to the residence. Why: architecture-spirit-human triad as its unique causal unit.

entries.name_han: 太上老君说天妃救苦灵验经
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that celestial compassion (天妃) is efficacious when suffering beings call with sincerity: rescue is a lawful response within a theistic-Daoist cosmos, not random miracle. It argues that devotion plus moral turning activates a named salvific office that specializes in peril at sea and analogous crises.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The cosmos includes responsive sacred persons/offices. 2) 天妃’s vow-field covers acute peril and wandering distress. 3) Sincere invocation + repentance opens the response channel. 4) “灵验” is claimed as repeatable efficacy under conditions. 5) Conclusion: relational devotion is a valid soteriological technology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In crisis luck years (Travel, Water hazards, isolation), combine practical safety with vow/recitation if client’s faith-framework allows. 2) Map “救苦” to concrete help networks, not only prayer. 3) Use the text’s logic to counter fatalism: response is possible. 4) Ethical preparation: stop harm-causing behavior that co-produces suffering. 5) Document outcomes as humility, not marketing.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 报父母恩重经’s filial accounting, this centers a female celestial rescuer’s vow. Unlike abstract Laozi ontology, it is devotional-soteriological. Difference: named office of compassion with testimonial efficacy structure.

entries.name_han: 太上洞玄灵宝天尊说救苦妙经
entries.logic_thesis: This Lingbao scripture proves that suffering is structurally addressable by the 救苦天尊’s universal vow: recitation realigns the soul with a salvation circuit that spans the ten directions. It argues that “妙” means the method is simple yet cosmically complete—sound, name, and intention open the path out of distress realms.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Beings cycle through painful states by karmic inertia. 2) 救苦天尊 establishes a counter-inertia of compassion. 3) Holding the name/scripture hooks the being into that counter-field. 4) Therefore liberation help is available without elite learning. 5) Conclusion: accessibility of salvation is itself a doctrinal proof of cosmic compassion.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts heavy in Kill/Empty/loss patterns, pair forecast with practices that reduce despair (recitation, charity, counseling). 2) Teach clients a short daily 救苦 practice as emotional-spiritual first aid. 3) Read “ten directions” as expanding care beyond self-chart obsession. 4) In death/grief timing, use the scripture’s hope logic ethically. 5) Keep method simple: consistency over complexity.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 天妃经’s specialized maritime/female cult focus, 救苦妙经 is more universal Lingbao soteriology. Compared with 安宅经, the field is the soul-realms rather than the house. Why: universal vow + easy recitation as the logical center.

entries.logic_thesis: The encyclopedia proves that Daoism’s authority rests on organized totality: Three Caverns materials must be anthologized so practitioners can locate authentic teaching amid proliferation. It argues that “pearls in a pouch” are selected essentials—curation is a logical act that preserves orthodoxy and usability.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Scriptural mass without organization yields confusion. 2) Three Caverns provide a high-level architecture. 3) Anthology extracts portable “pearls.” 4) Users can then practice and teach from a coherent corpus. 5) Conclusion: bibliographic structure is doctrinal method, not mere librarianship.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build your BaZi/Daoist study pouch: core classics first, commentaries second, folklore last. 2) Tag techniques by cavern/level (cosmology, ritual, alchemy, ethics). 3) When sources conflict, prefer curated classical layers. 4) Create personal 珠囊 notes of only verified methods. 5) Teach students a map of the library before isolated tricks.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike single-author Quanzhen collections, it is multi-source anthology logic. Unlike 道教义枢’s abstract doctrinal pivots, it is materials assembly. Difference: selection-and-arrangement as the form of reasoning.

entries.logic_thesis: 道教义枢 proves that Daoist teachings, however diverse, hinge on a finite set of doctrinal pivots (义枢): clarify those hinges and the whole system becomes navigable. It argues that conceptual architecture—body, spirit, Dao, practice ranks—prevents sectarian drift and empty ritualism.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Practices without doctrinal hinges become superstition or aesthetics. 2) The text isolates key meanings that organize all lesser topics. 3) With pivots fixed, rituals and alchemy find their places. 4) Disputes can be adjudicated by reference to hinges, not fashion. 5) Conclusion: systematic theology/philosophy is necessary for living Daoism.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For each BaZi technique, state its hinge: balance? image? response? ethics? 2) Build a one-page 义枢 of your consulting philosophy. 3) When learning a new school, map it onto existing pivots before adopting. 4) Audit practice: which actions serve no hinge? cut them. 5) Use pivots to explain forecasts to clients without occult fog.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with 三洞珠囊’s anthology approach, 义枢 is conceptual system-building. Compared with Laozi 注/传, it systematizes the whole religion, not one classic. Why distinct: hinge-concepts as the master logic of orthodoxy and practice integration.
